question: Within each released MVT image and assigned exposure cell, does selecting the three lowest positive recorded response_time values distort the recorded response distribution more than an equal-count uniform subset?
decision: Qualify a possible future timing-aware observation adapter; do not implement an online acquisition policy or reopen a product-value case.
exposure: Source methods and authors published speed/accuracy association read; archive acquired and metadata/timing audit executed before freeze. Header, counts, duration values, one negative time and absence of within-cell repeated IDs known. No category outcomes or timing/category association inspected. Exploratory, not blinded, preregistered or independent replication.

source.terms: MVT official download page and v1.0 datacard grant annotation CC BY-SA; version unspecified. Private analysis only. No raw annotations, identifiers, images or paper payload redistributed. Commercial deployment rights and version unresolved.

population.origin: objectnet field; exact values inspected only during execution; require one origin per image/cell and two source categories, report actual strings without inferred coercion
population.membership: Every CSV row preserved in accounting; physical zero-based data-row position is stable identity, not the unlabeled CSV index or authenticated human. Verify no within-cell repeated worker ID, seven rows each, all six durations per image. Any mismatch aborts.

observation.category: Exact nonempty response string; label is not used as truth or primary endpoint. Preserve every response value as a categorical outcome. Missing/empty response aborts; do not impute. No external normalization.
observation.timing: Decimal finite strictly positive recorded response_time only. Missing, nonnumeric, nonfinite and nonpositive times are excluded from timed selection, counted by reason. Units, event implementation and cross-worker clock calibration unverified: ranking lower released values only, not physical speed.
observation.unknowns: Original excluded229images unavailable; source filtering, worker identity, repeated participation, options/motor effects, browser timing and generalization remain unqualified.

analysis.timed_pool: Same valid-time records in both arms; n>=3 required for each analyzed cell. Cells with fewer remain explicit excluded-cell ledger entries, no replacement. Expected one n6,28625n7 from metadata audit.
analysis.primary_reference: p_R: categorical proportions over the valid-time pool. Observed cohort comparator, not physical truth.
analysis.selection: Order valid records by Decimal response_time then physical data-row position; choose first3. No original label or answer used to break timing ties.
analysis.primary_metric: Squared Euclidean distribution distance D=sum_c(q_c-p_R,c)^2; exact rational arithmetic.
analysis.uniform_baseline: Enumerate every size3 subset from the same timed pool; independent formula (n-3)/(3*(n-1))*(1-sum_c p_R,c^2). For n=3 this is zero. Verify exact agreement.
analysis.contrast: Delta = equal-cell mean(D_selected - E[D_uniform]); positive contradicts no-more-distorting assertion on this finite released cohort only. No practical threshold, population p-value, iid interval or multiplicity-adjusted discovery claimed.
analysis.timing_ties: Count boundary ties; enumerate all selections consistent with the three-lowest rule at tied boundary. Report exact aggregate lower/upper Delta over these per-cell choices. Main row-order result remains primary.
analysis.missing_timing: Separately report squared distance between full seven-response p_all and p_R, invalid-time rows/cells and coverage. Do not mix this with timing-order contrast.
analysis.modal_secondary: Unique selected mode equals unique timed-pool mode => agree; both unique but different => disagree; either tied => unresolved. Uniform counterpart is exact expected count over all subsets; keep denominators all admitted cells.
analysis.strata: All cells equal weight; report each of six assigned durations, each actual source-origin value and each duration×origin stratum; do not select favorable stratum.
analysis.trace: Retain exact per-cell fractions and membership digest privately, no raw worker/image identifiers in public artifacts. Public aggregates, authored scripts and source descriptors only.

acceptance.structural: Exact member SHA/CSV CRC/length/header/roster verified before result accepted; unknown source mismatch aborts.
acceptance.arithmetic: Separately authored checker streams original member with its own loader, enumerates all subsets and verifies per-cell metrics/modal/tie outputs and all aggregate fractions. No producer imports.
acceptance.repeatability: Two network-denied producer executions byte-identical. Both implementations frozen before empirical execution.
acceptance.controls: Authored unanimous, split, plurality-tie, tied-time, invalid-time cases; exact uniform formula agrees with enumeration; altered input bytes and altered output rejected. Failures retained; corrections disclosed.
acceptance.falsifier: Positive Delta disproves the narrow finite-record no-more-distorting premise. Zero or negative does not establish timing independence, scientific superiority, valid truth, causal deadline benefit or transfer.

stop: Stop after one frozen finite-record comparison and validation, regardless of result. No tuning k, changing metric, fresh dataset hunt, selector build, model campaign or product expansion. Broad superiority remains unestablished.
